name: Meta Ads Performance
description: Read Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad performance from the official Marketing API: spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, CPM, reach and attributed conversions (purchases, leads, ROAS) at account, campaign, ad set or ad level; daily/weekly/monthly time series; breakdowns by age, gender, country, placement and device; campaign/ad set/ad listings with status, objective and budget; and period-over-period comparisons ranked by what moved. Requires a META_ACCESS_TOKEN secret — a user or system-user token with the ads_read permission (plus META_APP_SECRET only if the app requires appsecret_proof). Read-only; pinned to Graph API v26.0. An independent client for the Meta Marketing API — not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Meta.
